status: PARTIAL: transformer-circuits.pub, support.apple.com, store.google.com, m3.material.io did not resolve from this session (network allowlist). Figures of S1 are images without alt text, so their visual form is NOT verified. Everything not in sources is marked simplified.

sources.what: S1 page: captions and text of the poem-planning figure (rabbit suppressed -> habit, green injected -> green), limits ('only captures a fraction of the total computation'). Figure images have empty alt text; their drawing was not seen.

Glossary (page now served at /docs/en/about-claude/glossary): Tokens = 'words, subwords, characters, or even bytes'; text 'encoded into a series of tokens'; Pretraining = 'predict the next word, given the previous context'; Temperature = 'controls the randomness of a model's predictions'.

Base Pixel 9 spec page: 152.8 x 72 x 8.5 mm (height x width x depth), 6.3 in display, 1080x2424, 20:9. principle.what happens: Reply appears on the screen in pieces; each piece is appended after the previous one.
principle.speed or time: not sourced; pick a readable rate (about 0.15-0.3 s per piece in the film)
principle.source: D1 ('writes text one word at a time', per sources.md S1 check)

principle.what happens: Text is encoded into tokens: words, subwords, characters, bytes.
The model is trained to predict the next piece from the previous context; one piece is chosen and appended, then the cycle repeats.
Choice randomness is controlled by temperature (not shown as dice).
Poem: 'rabbit' as end-word is planned before line 2 begins; suppressing it gives 'habit'; injecting 'green' gives a line ending in 'green'.
The method captures only a fraction of the computation; it was studied on one model (Claude 3.5 Haiku per sources.md).

proportions: Phone 152.8 : 72 : 8.5 mm (height : width : thickness), ratio about 2.12 : 1; thickness about 5.6% of height. Screen about 6.3 in diagonal, 20:9. Stand lip about 8-10 mm tall, phone leaning back about 70 deg; stand footprint about 1.2 x phone width. Chat UI: bubble text must stay at least the sizes required for legibility (Frontal rules, 26 px+ for labels in the frame). Token board: tile height equal, width proportional to character count (design choice); candidate bars clearly different lengths.
cutaways: Phone: front glass/screen layer lifted -> display panel -> battery and board (only if a scene needs it; the storyboard needs none, so the phone stays outside-only)
Token board: the answer row slides off the screen, splits into tiles, then candidate column appears
Graph C: lower tier of the board becomes transparent (camera goes below the board) to show nodes/edges; dim nodes fade except a few
pitfalls: No brand, no logo, no real app UI copy; no Claude logo or trademarked wordmark (brief).
A phone drawn lying flat (existing kit pose) contradicts the stand scene: use the upright pose.
'Token = letter' (S1 pitfalls in storyboard): tile lengths vary, only one tile is a symbol.
Bars without numbers must not read as probabilities in percent; no axis, no unit (analysis.md 8.4).
Selected tile coral = chosen token, always one coral part per frame, one meaning.
The graph is a schematic of features, not a brain and not a mechanism; do not draw neurons, wires of a chip or a head.
Do not show the researcher's hand; label 'эксперимент исследователей'.
Not 'Claude always plans': one model, part of computation (D1).

verified: D1 caption: the poem figure has three sections: upper = no intervention, model plans 'rabbit'; middle = 'rabbit' suppressed, model uses another planned rhyme (text: line ends in 'habit'); lower = 'green' injected, model plans a different ending (text: line ends in 'green').
D1 lists further figures (multilingual, mental math, faithfulness, multi-step 'Dallas', hallucinations 'Michael Jordan'/'Michael Batkin', jailbreaks) as images with captions only.
